caption: The drawing features a single, large, gray, three-dimensional object centered within a lightly outlined rectangular frame. The object resembles a bowl or pot with a rounded bottom and a thick rim that flares outward in four equally spaced, rounded-lobe extensions. The surface of the object is shaded to convey volume and a stone-like texture, with darker areas on one side to suggest a light source from the upper left. The rim of the bowl is relatively wide compared to the depth of the interior, which is shown as a dark circular recess. In the lower right corner of the frame, there is a smaller, technical line drawing of the same object. This inset provides a side-profile cross-section, complete with measurements indicated by lines and numbers, further clarifying the dimensions and the construction of the object. The background is off-white, and the artist's name, Cordena Jackson, is written below the main drawing.
title: Water Filter
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
